messages:
Maya Khan: Quick thought — can we show a per-route permission cost badge in the console? small UI chip that estimates token/quota impact when you grant a role to a route.
Liam Wong: Interesting. concrete example?
Maya Khan: e.g., route /v1/generate + role 'app_writer' -> badge: "~120 tokens/req (est)" or "~7% monthly quota". tooltip shows assumptions.
Jordan P.: Love the UX idea. Will need a simulate API behind the button.
Archit Rao: Simulation could be expensive if done naively. We should derive from telemetry histograms instead of replaying requests.
Maya Khan: Agreed. Proposal: add internal endpoint to compute estimate from metrics: returns tokens_per_request_p50/p95 and estimated quota burn for window.
Maya Khan: Example API draft:```POST /internal/permissions/simulate
{"route":"/v1/generate","role":"app_writer","window_hours":24}
Response: {"p50_tokens":"85","p95_tokens":"240","est_tokens_per_min":"12.5","assumptions":"uses tenant routing sample v2"}```
Liam Wong: We need to add a telemetry field too so customers can see why the number changed over time, e.g. perm_cost_estimate with sample_version and model_shard.
Archit Rao: Implementation approach: store per-route token-length histogram in metrics (Prom or TSDB) with labels {route, model_variant, tenant_tier}. Query percentiles and combine with expected request rate given role grants.
Jordan P.: On rollout UX: default should be off for orgs that haven't opted in (privacy). show "estimate disabled — enable telemetry" CTA.
Maya Khan: Good call. Also enterprise toggle in admin settings to opt into cost previews.
Archit Rao: Caveat: different roles can change behavior (more completion length). We'll need to associate role->prompt templates or default params for simulation. Otherwise numbers will be misleading.
Liam Wong: Maybe show a small confidence bar: low/medium/high based on sample size + model variance.
Maya Khan: Also propose a caching layer: compute estimate once/day per (route,role,tenant) and invalidate on new rollout or model change.
ops-bot: deploy scheduled: metrics-ingest v2 -> can surface histograms after 2h of warmup :robot_face:
Jordan P.: UI layout idea: inline badge + hover tooltip + "simulate" button that opens a modal with breakdown (p50/p95, sample window, assumptions).
Liam Wong: Need schema change for console API. I'll draft a spec for new field `permission_cost_preview` that includes p50,p95,confidence,assumptions.
Maya Khan: Action items: Maya -> PR with API spec + UX mock. Liam -> telemetry schema + console contract. Archit -> perf checklist for histogram queries. Jordan -> modal mock. ops-bot: notify when metrics-ingest v2 deployed.
Archit Rao: One more note — avoid exposing cross-tenant raw samples. only aggregated metrics. privacy first.
Maya Khan: Yup. privacy + enterprise opt-in. Thanks all.
Liam Wong: SGTM, will kick off. :thumbsup:
